title: SG-5.2 Frozen-ids reader on the contribution file store
summary: Add FrozenIDs to the contribution FileStore and assert it implements ExportSource
description: Context: backend/internal/contribution/store.go has FileStore (Save, Get, ListByRound) and export_source.go declares ExportSource with ListByRound and a compile-time assertion for *FileStore. A closed round's frozen contribution list lives in worlds/<world>/rounds/<round-lowercase>/snapshot.yaml (round.Snapshot, entries with id). Desired behavior: FileStore reads that file, returns the frozen contribution ids, returns ErrNotFound cleanly when no snapshot exists, and validates world and round ids. Why: the devion workseed handoff export needs only frozen contributions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a round dir with snapshot.yaml listing ids a and b, when FrozenIDs(ctx, world, round) is called, then it returns [a b] in snapshot order
Given a round with no snapshot.yaml, when FrozenIDs is called, then it returns an error satisfying errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound)
Given a world or round id that is not a safe path segment, when FrozenIDs is called, then it returns an error and reads no file
Given the contribution package, when it compiles, then *FileStore is asserted to implement ExportSource including FrozenIDs

out_of_scope: Changing snapshot writing in the round package
preserve: Existing Save, Get, ListByRound, ListByPlayer behavior

technical_constraints: Go backend; use gopkg.in/yaml.v3 already used by the round package
Use safepath.Segment for id validation like ListByRound
